versions.changelog:
x-mastery-mentor v1.0.0

- Launches highly specialized X/Twitter growth mentor for AI/tech content creators.
- Distills frameworks from six top $1M+/year X creators plus open-source X algorithm analysis.
- Features 6 core mental models, 10 decision heuristics, and an actionable X content ops guide.
- Advanced routing: custom responses across ideation, writing, growth, algorithm, branding, monetization, and audit scenarios.
- Context-aware: triggers even for casual/incomplete X-related queries in both Chinese and English.
- Built-in quality control, platform-specific algorithm notes, and explicit boundaries for supported use cases.
